review_description: From the initial quote to the finished installation of this install was very professionally done. Very prompt service and a very neat and tidy install. I highly recommend Greenfield Energy to anybody looking for a solar install. I am one very satisfied customerRobinMirriwinni

Quoting: They were there when they said they would be there. They confirmed the meeting and provided several different options for components, size of system etc. The material and quotes were all of a professional standard.Installation: Polite and respectful tradesmen who cleaned their rubbish including tiles. They let us know what they were doing, what the impact (minimal) would be on us during the day and were finished a couple of hours earlier than I expected.Customer Service: The responses have been fast and to the point. The system has only been in for a week, however, I am confident the after-sales will be of the same high standard as every other part of the process thus far.I would happily recommend this local company to anyone in Far North Queensland.

Jack and his crew made the whole installation painless and easily understood, very professional and prompt service, from getting original quote to installation in under 2 weeks.Couldn't recommend Jack & Greenfield Energy highly enough.
Superb service, great bloke. Always on hand to help with my none stop questions. Cheers Jack.
